name: Compliance agent — 8-case golden set (D34 locale spread, PIPA + CAN-SPAM + DLP)
description: Phase 3.12 golden set per compliance.spec.md §7 + the deliverable spec. Mix of clear / block / require_human_review cases across the 4 D34 locales. Encodes the precision_no_false_clear ≥ 0.99 invariant (2026 PIPA amendment — false clear is extreme severity, 10% revenue fine). Full 200-case holdout (tests/golden/compliance/*.json) lands during Phase 4 calibration with the live SDP + Spanner consent ledger.

metadata.extreme_severity_property: ANY 'clear' on a body containing critical PII (KR_RRN / US_SSN / CREDIT_CARD / PASSPORT_NUMBER / BANK_ACCOUNT) is a false clear — fails the run.

metadata.note: US CAN-SPAM 100% coverage — unsubscribe link present, physical address present, non-deceptive subject. Recipient consent on file. Safe send.
